title: Fearfully and Wonderfully Made?
question: What does it tell me about God that He made me so carefully, and how should I respond?
blurb: The same God who knit you together knows you completely - and that truth turns wonder into worship.

nodes.content: What does it tell me about God that He made me so carefully, and how should I respond?

nodes.verseText: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
“Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”

nodes.content: The psalmist's response to being so made is praise, not pride - 'I praise You.' Recognizing God's craftsmanship leads upward to worship of the Maker.
